mapper.select: SELECT FROM reconciliation_file_batch WHERE source_system = #{sourceSystem} AND object_key = #{objectKey} AND file_version = #{fileVersion}
SELECT FROM reconciliation_file_batch WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND file_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY file_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM reconciliation_file_batch WHERE source_system = #{sourceSystem} AND business_date = #{businessDate} AND file_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY file_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM reconciliation_file_batch WHERE status = #{status} AND file_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY file_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconciliation_file_batch (file_id, object_key, source_system, record_type, window_start, window_end, file_version, schema_version, sha256, record_count, byte_size, status, failure_reason, created_at, completed_at, batch_id, business_date, cutoff_at, actual_record_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{objectKey}, #{sourceSystem}, #{recordType}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{fileVersion}, #{schemaVersion}, #{sha256}, #{recordCount}, #{byteSize}, #{status}, #{failureReason}, #{createdAt}, #{completedAt}, #{batchId}, #{businessDate}, #{cutoffAt}, #{actualRecordCount}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (source_system, object_key, file_version) DO NOTHING
